sin.name: agent-row-id-in-text
sin.description: A text names an agent by its row id, such as worker {worker.id}, where a person knows the agent by its number in its environment.
sin.rule: A text names an agent through AgentLabel: AgentLabel.from_agent(agent).text, or AgentLabel.from_row_id(agent_id, numbers).text where only the row id is known.
